injury.comment: Jokic (right elbow sprain) is probable for Monday's game against the Rockets.
Murray (leg) is probable for Monday against Houston.
Barnes (adductor) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.
Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
Sabonis (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Heat.
Miller (groin) is listed as out for Monday's game against Cleveland.
Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
Quickley (hamstring) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Bane (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors.
Reaves is questionable for Monday's game against the Hawks due to an illness, per Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com.
Davis (ankle) is listed as questionable for Monday's game in Detroit.
George will not return to Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right ankle injury.
Powell (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.
Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.
DeRozan (back) is probable for Monday against Houston.
Markkanen (wrist) is out for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.

note: Projections, not prices: no sportsbook lines are used. Built from L5/L10/L15/L20 averages, opponent defense by position, head to head, rest and injuries. Early in the season the windows reach back into last year's games.

backtest.basis: 99 players, 2025-26 games after each player's 8th, one game ahead, no lines
backtest.read: The half and half blend is a hair better than the season average and better than the windows alone. Opponent defense and home/away added nothing measurable, so defense is applied at a small weight and the home/away split is shown but not applied. A typical miss on points is about 6, so treat every number as a range, not a pick.
